scripts.dev: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.copyFileSync('index.source.html', 'index.html');" && tsx server.ts
scripts.dev:staging: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.copyFileSync('index.source.html', 'index.html');" && tsx server.ts --staging
scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.copyFileSync('index.source.html', 'index.html');" && vite build && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'index.html'); fs.rmSync('assets', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('dist/assets', 'assets', { recursive: true });"
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; ['dist', 'server.js', 'assets'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
